answer: Miscellaneous >> Halal & Haram Question ID: 29523 Country: India Title: Is it allowed to work for an IT company that develop software for banking & financial firms? I mean is it okay to be a part of any such software development? Question: Is it allowed to work for an IT company that develop software for banking & financial firms? I mean is it okay to be a part of any such software development?? Answer ID: 29523 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 237/237/M=1432) In developing software if you have not to involve or support interest based jobs then it is allowable to work there, otherwise you should avoid. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
